- Milestone 1 (Commercial terms agreed / redlines logged): target 7/12 — owners: BlueRidge procurement (Priya), Redwood legal (Laura)

Redwood — BlueRidge Go/No-Go (one-page checklist):
- Commercial: Order form signed OR PO received for agreed amount (owner: procurement)
- DPA: BlueRidge legal returns either: 1) signed DPA; or 2) DPA with only negotiable notes (owner: legal)
- Security: SOC2 evidence provided and no blocking subprocessors (owner: security)
- Billing: Redwood confirms net-30 and billing contact (owner: finance)
- Pilot readiness: EdgeWorks receives API keys and test dataset; pilot smoke tests pass (owner: solutions)

Pilot acceptance tests (summary):
- Latency benchmark: 95p < 350ms for 2k qps synthetic load (approx numbers for pilot)
- Quality: sample eval set passes baseline thresholds (we'll share the eval set)
- Data handling: no PHI persisted outside controlled buckets during pilot

If the pilot fails any hard test we will propose a remediation window (48–72h) before delaying the signature.
